title: Software Engineer
intro: I build reliable software, automate testing, and make complex systems easier to monitor. My experience spans backend APIs, payment platforms, and cloud operations.
summary: Software engineer with a background in Computer Engineering and Digitalization from EMI. Focused on reliable, maintainable solutions and collaborative delivery in Agile teams.

ui.siteDescription: Imad Chakir, software engineer in Rabat. Experience, projects, technical skills, an interactive journey, and a downloadable CV.

bullets: Migrated the team’s monitoring solution from Elasticsearch- and Prometheus-based tooling to Oracle’s internal Telemetry services.
Developed scripts for metric collection and data streaming into Telemetry for ingestion, monitoring, and analysis.
Created Grafana dashboards and alarms to improve operational visibility and incident detection.
Automated API and platform testing with Selenium, Rest Assured, and Appium to expand validation coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
Contributed to APIs for payment request validation and payment gateway integration; worked across multiple payment methods and transaction flows.
Supported enterprise payment customers and built lightweight internal tools to simplify testing workflows and API understanding.
Contributed to early design and implementation work with Redis and Kafka to evaluate support for increasing transaction volumes.
Worked on web and mobile applications in an Agile environment, from planning and design to implementation and testing.
Used C#, Ionic, Postman, IIS, SQL Server, Python, UML, and Figma.
Contributed to a web and mobile application with chatbot support, from planning and modeling through development and testing.
Developed practical skills in software design, collaboration, and the full development lifecycle.
